schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The schema to copy into, as the caller holds it; null to start one.

from_schema.title: From Schema
from_schema.description: The schema to copy from, when it isn't a node's file (workflow_guid, node_guid and file).

key.title: Key
key.description: The message to copy: its name in the schema it is copied from.

name.title: Name
name.description: What to call it here; the same name by default.

replace.title: Replace
replace.description: Replace this schema's message of that name, rules and all. Without it, a name this schema has is a 409.
